Admin routes of the categories module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/categories

Get category tree (admin)

Responses:

- `200`: Category tree retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/categories

Create category

Request body: [CreateCategoryAdminDto](#createcategoryadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Category created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/categories/{id}

Delete category

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Category deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Category not found.
- `409`: Category has products.

## PATCH /v1/admin/categories/{id}

Update category

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateCategoryAdminDto](#updatecategoryadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Category updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Category not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/categories/reorder

Reorder categories

Request body: [ReorderCategoriesAdminDto](#reordercategoriesadmindto).

Responses:

- `204`: Categories reordered.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## Schemas

### CreateCategoryAdminDto

- `name` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), required).
- `slug` (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, required).
- `description` ([OptionalContentTranslatableDto](#optionalcontenttranslatabledto), optional).
- `parentId` (string, optional).
- `imageId` (string, optional).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `isVisible` (boolean, optional).
- `metaTitle` ([OptionalContentTranslatableDto](#optionalcontenttranslatabledto), optional).
- `metaDescription` ([OptionalContentTranslatableDto](#optionalcontenttranslatabledto), optional).

### OptionalContentTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, optional).

- `items` (array of [ReorderItemDto](#reorderitemdto), required).
